BDS modifications: execution budget (including empty loops), nested evaluation
and C stack limits, exported property getter, freestanding numeric output,
primitive string concatenation and non-integer numeric equality. See elk.c/h.
Browser DOM integration is in apps/browser_script.h. Upstream license: AGPL-3.0.
